readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine, at the end of dinner, when Aurèle had everyone bring out their watches
At the moment the temple bell struck nine (Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell)
When Vauthier and Madame Monnier stopped playing piquet and he decided to fetch his cigar case
When the hall clock struck eleven, a moment after Vauthier sat down again in the salon

durations: two minutes (Vauthier's watch was ahead of the temple bell)
a moment (between Vauthier sitting down again and the hall clock striking eleven)
whereabouts: At dinner, Vauthier was at the table with the household when the temple bell struck nine; Aurèle went round the table among them
Vauthier was in the salon with Madame Monnier when the house was woken
Vauthier played piquet with Madame Monnier in the salon until a quarter to eleven
Vauthier went out of the salon to the hall to fetch his cigar case, which was in his coat there
Madame Monnier began playing the piano in the salon as Vauthier went out
Madame Monnier stopped playing the piano when Vauthier came back
Vauthier came back and sat down again in the salon, where he lit a cigar
The cigar case was where Vauthier had left it in his coat in the hall
Vauthier took what he had in his bag to the scene where the body was
Vauthier looked at the regulator on the wall
